## Overview

The primary analysis of the study. It asks which pre-specified genes and programmes are associated with PSA response, rPFS and on-treatment change when the patient is the unit of inference. Counts are summed over each patient's AOIs within each compartment × timepoint stratum, normalised by TMM and analysed with batch as a covariate. This is the code of `comp_13_pseudobulk_primary` with one change: the gene universe in each stratum is the set of genes above the negative-probe limit of quantification in at least 10% of AOIs (from `comp_16_loq_filter`), instead of `filterByExpr`.

Key design choices: control-tissue AOIs (technical replicates) are excluded; genes selected in earlier analyses of these data form an explicitly exploratory family with its own FDR; robustness is assessed by excluding batch 3, which holds all intermediate patients, and by leave-one-patient-out refits; the PSA50 prediction is calibrated by label permutation.

Environment switches allow sensitivity runs without changing the code. The pipeline runs it twice: by default (output `C13_pseudobulk_LOQ`) and with `EXCL_LOW=1 C13_OUT=C13_pseudobulk_LOQ_exclLow`, which drops AOIs with fewer than 5% of genes above LOQ. The annotation-audit switches (`AUDIT_EXCL`, `SITE_MODE`, `TW_NR`, `SKIP_PRED`, `AOI_KEEP`) are off by default and leave the default run unchanged.

**Figures, tables and results supported**

- Fig. 2a, f, h (pseudobulk *FOLH1* versus PSA change per stratum; primary versus bone *FOLH1*), via comp_28/comp_41
- Fig. 3f (on-treatment PSMA⁺ *FOLH1* and rPFS), via comp_28/comp_41
- Fig. 4 (paired on-treatment programme change), via comp_28/comp_41
- Extended Data Fig. 1g (gene-level P-value distributions and π₁)
- Extended Data Fig. 4a (the `EXCL_LOW=1` run: low-signal AOIs excluded)
- Extended Data Fig. 8c, d (bone-niche genes across sensitivity analyses; elastic-net PSA50 prediction)
- Supplementary Tables 15–18, 20, 21 (via comp_47) and 24, 25 (via comp_25)
- Supplementary Data 1 (pseudobulk gene-level results, via comp_29) and 4 (via comp_48)
- Methods: Primary analysis: patient-level pseudobulk; Paired on-treatment and primary-to-bone analyses; Prediction (exploratory elastic net)
- The pseudobulk object `pseudobulk_strata.qs` is read by most later analysis scripts

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 13b_pseudobulk_loq`; also run as step(s) `13b_exclLow` (see `steps.tsv`). Approximate runtime: tens of minutes per run (dominated by the cross-validated PSA50 prediction with 100 label permutations; SKIP_PRED=1 skips it).

## Analysis

Header: the LOQ gene universe replaces the `filterByExpr` gene set of comp_13, followed by the environment switches for sensitivity runs and the original description of sections A–F.

### Set-up and feature definitions
Loads the bone-only AOI object, clinical table and reference gene sets, and fixes the seed. Defines the excluded artefact-prone probe families, the a priori genes (*FOLH1*, *B2M*, *CD276*), the post hoc genes (*CHGA*, *IBSP*, *CTSK*) and the literature programmes; the bone-remodelling module, selected on response in an earlier analysis, is kept in a separate post hoc list. Later scripts (comp_48, 49, 50, 52) re-read this block so that their feature definitions are identical.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE comprehensive analysis -- C13b: patient-level pseudobulk PRIMARY analysis on the
## negative-probe (LOQ) gene universe (comp_16_loq_filter.R) -- supersedes the filterByExpr
## gene set of comp_13. Env vars: C13_OUT (output folder), EXCL_LOW=1 drops AOIs with < 5%
## genes above the standard LOQ (sensitivity).
## Annotation-audit sensitivities (R34; all off by default, so the default run is unchanged):
##   AUDIT_EXCL=1  drop PanCK+PSMA- / PSMA+ AOIs of sample x segment units with no detectable tumour
##                 (C2_tumour_content_by_sample_segment.csv, KLK3 < 1.5 log2 above LOQ) and the SVH-007
##                 Archival PSMA+ AOIs (lab note "No PSMA+ tumour")
##   SITE_MODE=bone_only  keep documented bone on-study samples and prostate Archival samples only
##                        (results/C0_bone_cohort/documented_tissue_site.csv)
##   SITE_MODE=covariate  add non-bone site (lymph node / soft tissue) as a covariate where it varies
##   TW_NR=1       also run transcriptome-wide limma-voom for NR vs R (~ NR + batch [+ site])
##   SKIP_PRED=1   skip section F (PSA50 prediction)
##   AOI_KEEP=<csv> keep only the AOIs listed (column "aoi"), e.g. ESTIMATE purity selection (comp_64);
##                 strata with < 3 residual df are skipped in section C
## (derived from) PRINCE comprehensive analysis -- C13: patient-level pseudobulk PRIMARY analysis
## Adopted after the 2026-10-25 internal methods review: RUV-adjusted mixed models gave
## stronger associations than raw data (RUV W partly correlated with PSA change),
## so the primary inference is now patient-level pseudobulk with study_batch as a
## covariate; the RUV-based C4/C5 results are sensitivity analyses.
##   A. pseudobulk per patient x segment x timepoint (sum counts; TMM; artefact
##      probes removed; Control / DiseaseProgression excluded)
##   B. features: a-priori genes (FOLH1, B2M, CD276) and literature programmes;
##      post-hoc genes (CHGA, IBSP, CTSK, bone-remodel module -- selected from
##      earlier DE on these data) kept in a separate, explicitly exploratory family
##      tests: lm(feature ~ PSA change + batch); NR vs R (lm + batch, Wilcoxon);
##      Cox rPFS (plain and batch-stratified); sensitivity excluding batch_3;
##      leave-one-patient-out (LOPO) sign stability and max p
##   C. transcriptome-wide pseudobulk limma-voom (~ PSA change + batch)
##   D. paired Screening -> Cycle1 induction with a-priori sets (Hallmark P53,
##      Hallmark IFN-alpha, IFN-I); per-patient deltas vs response (descriptive)
##   E. primary -> metastasis FOLH1 concordance; FOLH1 ROI heterogeneity (raw logCPM)
##   F. PSA50 prediction: repeated stratified 5-fold CV elastic net + permutation p
##      (PSA50 re-derived from max PSA change; PMC-005 corrected)
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({
  library(qs); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(edgeR)
  library(limma); library(survival); library(glmnet); library(pROC)
})
setwd(PRINCE_DIR)
check_ram_or_stop(20)
set.seed(2026)

se <- qs::qread("phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs")
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
pt <- qs::qread(out_path("C1_clinical", "patient_table.qs"))
msig <- readRDS(file.path(PMCC_DIR, "msigdb_gene_sets.rds"))
sig_env <- new.env(); sys.source(file.path(PMCC_DIR, "ProstateCancer_GeneSignatures.R"), envir = sig_env)
artefact_re <- "^(USP17L|PRAMEF|NBPF|OR[0-9]+[A-Z]+[0-9]+)"
tp_levels <- c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")
segs <- c("CD45+", "PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-")
code <- c("CD45+" = "CD45", "PSMA+" = "PSMA", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCKPSMA")

apriori_genes <- c("FOLH1", "B2M", "CD276")
posthoc_genes <- c("CHGA", "IBSP", "CTSK")
programmes <- list(
  NEPC_up = c("ASCL1", "SOX2", "NKX2-1", "FOXA2", "INSM1", "CHGA", "CHGB", "SYP", "NCAM1", "EZH2", "AURKA", "MYCN", "PCSK1"),
  AR_panel = c("AR", "KLK3", "FOLH1", "NKX3-1", "HOXB13"),
  Hallmark_androgen = msig$H$HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE,
  IFN_I = sig_env$immune_sigs$IFN_I,
  IFN_I_STING_tumour = c("IRF9", "STAT1", "IRF7", "OAS1", "STING1", "TMEM173", "B2M"),
  MHC_I = sig_env$immune_sigs$MHC_I, MHC_II = sig_env$immune_sigs$MHC_II,
  Tcell_inflamed_GEP = sig_env$immune_sigs$Tcell_inflamed_GEP,
  T_exhaustion = sig_env$immune_sigs$T_exhaustion, Treg = sig_env$immune_sigs$Treg,
  Cytotoxic_effector = sig_env$immune_sigs$Cytotoxic_effector,
  TGFb_response = sig_env$immune_sigs$TGFb_response_FTBRS,
  Bone_TAM_TIM = c("FOLR2", "SIGLEC1", "LYVE1", "SPP1", "IL4R", "CD200R1", "CD101", "LYZ", "S100A9", "S100A12",
                   "APOE", "TGFB1", "C1QA", "C1QB", "C1QC", "FN1", "MMP9", "IL1RN", "CD163", "CLEC7A", "TREM1",
                   "FCN1", "CSTA", "VCAN", "PLAUR"),
  Osteoclast = c("ACP5", "CTSK", "MMP9", "OSCAR", "CALCR", "TNFRSF11A", "DCSTAMP", "OCSTAMP", "NFATC1"),
  Osteoblast = c("RUNX2", "SP7", "BGLAP", "ALPL", "COL1A1", "IBSP", "SPP1", "SPARC", "PHEX", "DMP1"),
  Hallmark_P53 = msig$H$HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY,
  Hallmark_IFNa = msig$H$HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE)
posthoc_programmes <- list(Bone_remodel_module = c("IBSP", "CTSK", "MMP3", "SMAD7"))

```

### A. Pseudobulk on the LOQ gene universe
Selects non-control AOIs and applies any active sensitivity filters: low-signal AOIs (`EXCL_LOW`), sample × compartment units without detectable tumour (`AUDIT_EXCL`), an explicit AOI list (`AOI_KEEP`) or documented non-bone sites (`SITE_MODE`). Because the input object is already bone-only, the site switches have no effect on the released cohort. Counts are summed per patient within each stratum; each patient-stratum must come from a single batch. The gene universe is the stratum's ≥10% LOQ set (`g10`), and TMM log-CPM is computed on it.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-02}
## ---- A. pseudobulk ---------------------------------------------------------------------
keep_aoi <- cd$response_group_neat != "Control" & cd$timepoint %in% tp_levels
OUT <- Sys.getenv("C13_OUT", "C13_pseudobulk_LOQ")
loq <- qs::qread(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "loq_gene_universes.qs"))
uni <- loq$universes
if (Sys.getenv("EXCL_LOW") == "1") {
  low <- rownames(loq$aoi)[loq$aoi$pct_above_LOQ_std < 5]
  keep_aoi <- keep_aoi & !(rownames(cd) %in% low)
  cat("Excluding", sum(rownames(cd) %in% low), "low-signal AOIs\n")
}
AUDIT_DIR <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R34_annotation_audit")
SITE_MODE <- Sys.getenv("SITE_MODE", "none")
site_tab <- read.csv(file.path(COMP_DIR, "C0_bone_cohort", "documented_tissue_site.csv"))
site_tab$nonbone <- as.integer(!grepl("^(BONE|PROSTATE)", site_tab$region_summary) |
                                 grepl("lymph", site_tab$region, ignore.case = TRUE))
cd$site_nonbone <- site_tab$nonbone[match(paste(cd$subject_id, cd$timepoint), paste(site_tab$subject_id, site_tab$timepoint))]
cd$site_nonbone[is.na(cd$site_nonbone)] <- 0L
if (Sys.getenv("AUDIT_EXCL") == "1") {
  tc <- read.csv(file.path(AUDIT_DIR, "C2_tumour_content_by_sample_segment.csv"))
  none <- tc$status == "none"
  drop <- paste(cd$subject_id, cd$timepoint, cd$segment_name) %in% paste(tc$subject_id, tc$timepoint, tc$segment_name)[none] |
    (cd$subject_id == "SVH-007" & cd$timepoint == "Archival" & cd$segment_name == "PSMA+")
  cat("AUDIT_EXCL: dropping", sum(drop & keep_aoi), "AOIs\n")
  keep_aoi <- keep_aoi & !drop
}
if (Sys.getenv("AOI_KEEP") != "") {
  kk <- read.csv(Sys.getenv("AOI_KEEP"))$aoi
  cat("AOI_KEEP: keeping", sum(keep_aoi & rownames(cd) %in% kk), "of", sum(keep_aoi), "AOIs\n")
  keep_aoi <- keep_aoi & rownames(cd) %in% kk
}
if (SITE_MODE == "bone_only") {
  cat("SITE_MODE bone_only: dropping", sum(keep_aoi & cd$site_nonbone == 1), "non-bone / non-prostate AOIs\n")
  keep_aoi <- keep_aoi & cd$site_nonbone == 0
}
counts_all <- assay(se, "all_count")
counts_all <- counts_all[!grepl(artefact_re, rownames(counts_all)), ]
pb_make <- function(idx) {
  d <- cd[idx, ]
  grp <- paste(d$subject_id, d$timepoint, sep = "|")
  m <- sapply(split(seq_len(nrow(d)), grp), function(i) rowSums(counts_all[, rownames(d)[i], drop = FALSE]))
  meta <- d %>% mutate(key = grp) %>% group_by(key) %>%
    summarise(subject_id = first(subject_id), timepoint = first(timepoint), n_aoi = n(),
              study_batch = first(study_batch), n_batches = n_distinct(study_batch),
              site_nonbone = first(site_nonbone), .groups = "drop")
  meta <- meta[match(colnames(m), meta$key), ] %>%
    left_join(pt %>% select(subject_id, response_group_neat, max_psa_change, psa_change_capped,
                            r_pfstime, r_pfsevent, PSA50), by = "subject_id")
  stopifnot(all(meta$n_batches == 1))
  list(counts = m, meta = as.data.frame(meta))
}
pbs <- list()
for (sg in segs) for (tp in tp_levels) {
  p <- pb_make(which(keep_aoi & cd$segment_name == sg & cd$timepoint == tp))
  dge <- DGEList(p$counts)
  keep <- rownames(dge) %in% uni[[paste0(code[sg], "__", tp)]]$g10
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE])
  p$lcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); p$dge <- dge
  p$meta$log_lib <- log10(colSums(p$counts))
  pbs[[paste0(code[sg], "__", tp)]] <- p
}
cat("Pseudobulk strata (patients):\n"); print(sapply(pbs, function(p) ncol(p$lcpm)))

```

Feature matrix: log-CPM for single genes and mean z-scored log-CPM for programmes with at least three genes in the universe. Each feature is labelled as a priori gene, a priori programme or post hoc (exploratory), which defines the FDR families in section B.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-03}
feat_matrix <- function(p) {
  z <- t(scale(t(p$lcpm)))
  gene_f <- t(p$lcpm[intersect(c(apriori_genes, posthoc_genes), rownames(p$lcpm)), , drop = FALSE])
  prog_f <- sapply(c(programmes, posthoc_programmes), function(g) {
    g <- intersect(g, rownames(z)); if (length(g) >= 3) colMeans(z[g, , drop = FALSE]) else rep(NA, ncol(z)) })
  cbind(gene_f, prog_f)
}
family_of <- function(f) ifelse(f %in% c(posthoc_genes, names(posthoc_programmes)), "post-hoc (exploratory)",
                          ifelse(f %in% apriori_genes, "a-priori gene", "a-priori programme"))

```

### B. Pre-specified feature tests
Per stratum and feature: feature ~ PSA change (per 50%) + batch (plus site when `SITE_MODE=covariate`); Spearman correlation with maximal PSA change; non-responder versus responder by linear model with batch and Wilcoxon test (intermediate patients excluded); Cox regression for rPFS per s.d., unstratified and batch-stratified; refit without batch 3; leave-one-patient-out sign stability and largest P. The helper returns NA when the outcome is aliased in very small strata. BH-FDR within stratum and feature family.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-04}
## ---- B. feature tests ----------------------------------------------------------------------
fit_lm <- function(y, x, batch, site = NULL) {
  ok <- complete.cases(y, x)
  b <- factor(batch[ok])
  f <- if (nlevels(droplevels(b)) > 1) lm(y[ok] ~ x[ok] + b) else lm(y[ok] ~ x[ok])
  if (!is.null(site) && length(unique(site[ok])) > 1) f <- update(f, . ~ . + site[ok])
  s <- summary(f)$coefficients
  if (!"x[ok]" %in% rownames(s)) return(c(NA, NA))   # outcome aliased (very small strata)
  c(s["x[ok]", 1], s["x[ok]", 4])
}
cox_p <- function(time, event, x, strata = NULL) {
  ok <- complete.cases(time, event, x)
  if (sum(event[ok]) < 3) return(c(NA, NA, NA, NA))
  f <- if (is.null(strata)) coxph(Surv(time[ok], event[ok]) ~ scale(x[ok])) else
    coxph(Surv(time[ok], event[ok]) ~ scale(x[ok]) + strata(strata[ok]))
  ci <- exp(confint(f)); c(exp(coef(f))[1], ci[1, 1], ci[1, 2], summary(f)$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}
res <- list()
for (sid in names(pbs)) {
  p <- pbs[[sid]]; m <- p$meta; F <- feat_matrix(p)
  site <- if (SITE_MODE == "covariate") m$site_nonbone else NULL
  psa <- m$psa_change_capped / 50
  nr <- ifelse(m$response_group_neat == "Non_Responder", 1, ifelse(m$response_group_neat == "Responder", 0, NA))
  for (f in colnames(F)) {
    y <- F[, f]; if (all(is.na(y))) next
    a <- fit_lm(y, psa, m$study_batch, site)
    sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(y, m$max_psa_change, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    b <- fit_lm(y, nr, m$study_batch, site)
    w <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(y[nr == 1], y[nr == 0], exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
    cx <- cox_p(m$r_pfstime, m$r_pfsevent, y); cxs <- cox_p(m$r_pfstime, m$r_pfsevent, y, m$study_batch)
    nb3 <- m$study_batch != "batch_3"
    a3 <- fit_lm(y[nb3], psa[nb3], m$study_batch[nb3], site[nb3])
    lopo <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(m)), function(i) fit_lm(y[-i], psa[-i], m$study_batch[-i], site[-i]))
    res[[paste(sid, f)]] <- data.frame(
      stratum = sid, feature = f, family = family_of(f), n = sum(!is.na(y)), n_nonbone = sum(m$site_nonbone),
      n_NR = sum(nr == 1, na.rm = TRUE), n_R = sum(nr == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      beta_psa = a[1], p_psa = a[2], rho = unname(sp$estimate), p_rho = sp$p.value,
      beta_NR = b[1], p_NR = b[2], p_wilcox = w,
      HR = cx[1], HR_lo = cx[2], HR_hi = cx[3], p_cox = cx[4], HR_strat = cxs[1], p_cox_strat = cxs[4],
      beta_psa_no_b3 = a3[1], p_psa_no_b3 = a3[2],
      lopo_sign_stable = mean(sign(lopo[1, ]) == sign(a[1])), lopo_max_p = max(lopo[2, ]))
  }
}
res <- bind_rows(res) %>% group_by(stratum, family) %>%
  mutate(fdr_psa = p.adjust(p_psa, "BH"), fdr_NR = p.adjust(p_NR, "BH"), fdr_cox = p.adjust(p_cox, "BH")) %>% ungroup()

```

### C. Transcriptome-wide pseudobulk limma-voom
Design ~ PSA change (per 50%) + batch, robust empirical Bayes; strata with fewer than three residual degrees of freedom are skipped, and aliased columns are dropped by QR pivoting. With `TW_NR=1` a non-responder versus responder model (~ NR + batch) is also fitted. The summary records genes at FDR < 0.1 and < 0.05 and selected named genes; gene-level results for every stratum are kept for π₁ estimation and Supplementary Data 1.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-05}
## ---- C. transcriptome-wide pseudobulk limma ------------------------------------------------
tw <- list(); tw_genes <- list(); tw_nr_genes <- list()
for (sid in names(pbs)) {
  p <- pbs[[sid]]; m <- p$meta
  X <- if (length(unique(m$study_batch)) > 1) model.matrix(~ I(psa_change_capped / 50) + study_batch, m) else
    model.matrix(~ I(psa_change_capped / 50), m)
  colnames(X)[2] <- "psa"
  if (nrow(X) - qr(X)$rank < 3 || qr(X)$rank < ncol(X) && !"psa" %in% colnames(X[, qr(X)$pivot[seq_len(qr(X)$rank)], drop = FALSE])) {
    cat("skip", sid, ": too few patients\n"); next }
  if (SITE_MODE == "covariate" && length(unique(m$site_nonbone)) > 1) X <- cbind(X, site_nonbone = m$site_nonbone)
  X <- X[, qr(X)$pivot[seq_len(qr(X)$rank)], drop = FALSE]
  fit <- eBayes(lmFit(voom(p$dge, X), X), robust = TRUE)
  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = "psa", number = Inf)
  nr_counts <- c(NA, NA); nr_look <- NA
  if (Sys.getenv("TW_NR") == "1") {
    k <- m$response_group_neat %in% c("Responder", "Non_Responder"); mk <- m[k, ]
    mk$nr <- as.integer(mk$response_group_neat == "Non_Responder")
    Xn <- if (length(unique(mk$study_batch)) > 1) model.matrix(~ nr + study_batch, mk) else model.matrix(~ nr, mk)
    if (SITE_MODE == "covariate" && length(unique(mk$site_nonbone)) > 1) Xn <- cbind(Xn, site_nonbone = mk$site_nonbone)
    Xn <- Xn[, qr(Xn)$pivot[seq_len(qr(Xn)$rank)], drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(Xn) - ncol(Xn) < 3 || !"nr" %in% colnames(Xn) || length(unique(mk$nr)) < 2) { Xn <- NULL }
  }
  if (Sys.getenv("TW_NR") == "1" && !is.null(Xn)) {
    dk <- p$dge[, k]
    ttn <- topTable(eBayes(lmFit(voom(dk, Xn), Xn), robust = TRUE), coef = "nr", number = Inf)
    tw_nr_genes[[sid]] <- ttn %>% mutate(gene = rownames(ttn), stratum = sid)
    nr_counts <- c(sum(ttn$adj.P.Val < 0.05), sum(ttn$adj.P.Val < 0.1))
    nr_look <- if ("FOLH1" %in% rownames(ttn)) sprintf("%.3g (P %.2g, logFC %.2f)", ttn["FOLH1", "adj.P.Val"],
                                                        ttn["FOLH1", "P.Value"], ttn["FOLH1", "logFC"]) else NA
  }
  tw_genes[[sid]] <- tt %>% mutate(gene = rownames(tt), stratum = sid)
  look <- function(g) if (g %in% rownames(tt)) sprintf("%.3g (P %.2g)", tt[g, "adj.P.Val"], tt[g, "P.Value"]) else NA
  tw[[sid]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, n_patients = ncol(p$lcpm), n_genes = nrow(tt),
                          fdr10 = sum(tt$adj.P.Val < 0.1), fdr05 = sum(tt$adj.P.Val < 0.05),
                          FOLH1 = look("FOLH1"), IBSP = look("IBSP"), CHGA = look("CHGA"), CD276 = look("CD276"),
                          n_nonbone = sum(m$site_nonbone), NR_fdr05 = nr_counts[1], NR_fdr10 = nr_counts[2], NR_FOLH1 = nr_look)
}
tw <- bind_rows(tw)

```

### D. Paired pre- to on-treatment change
For patients with tissue at both bone timepoints, a joint pseudobulk over the union of the two timepoints' LOQ universes is fitted with ~ patient + timepoint (limma-voom, robust). Six pre-specified programmes (Hallmark p53, Hallmark IFN-α, IFN-I, IFN-I/STING, HLA class I and II) are scored; the per-patient change is tested by Wilcoxon signed-rank test, compared between response groups and correlated with PSA change. Compartments with fewer than three pairs are skipped.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-06}
## ---- D. paired Screening -> Cycle1 induction ----------------------------------------------
pair_res <- list(); pair_delta <- list(); pair_genes <- list()
for (sg in segs) {
  idx <- which(keep_aoi & cd$segment_name == sg & cd$timepoint %in% c("Screening", "Cycle1"))
  p <- pb_make(idx); m <- p$meta
  both <- names(which(table(m$subject_id) == 2))
  sel <- m$subject_id %in% both
  if (length(both) < 3) { cat("skip paired", sg, ": fewer than 3 pairs\n"); next }
  dge <- DGEList(p$counts[, sel]); m <- m[sel, ]
  g_pair <- union(uni[[paste0(code[sg], "__Screening")]]$g10, uni[[paste0(code[sg], "__Cycle1")]]$g10)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge[rownames(dge) %in% g_pair, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE])
  m$post <- as.integer(m$timepoint == "Cycle1")
  X <- model.matrix(~ factor(subject_id) + post, m)
  if (SITE_MODE == "covariate") {   # site changes within patient only for SVH-008 (soft tissue -> bone)
    X <- cbind(X, site_nonbone = m$site_nonbone); X <- X[, qr(X)$pivot[seq_len(qr(X)$rank)], drop = FALSE]
  }
  fit <- eBayes(lmFit(voom(dge, X), X), robust = TRUE)
  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = "post", number = Inf)
  pair_genes[[sg]] <- tt %>% mutate(gene = rownames(tt), segment = sg)
  lc <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); z <- t(scale(t(lc)))
  for (s in c("Hallmark_P53", "Hallmark_IFNa", "IFN_I", "IFN_I_STING_tumour", "MHC_I", "MHC_II")) {
    g <- intersect(programmes[[s]], rownames(z)); sc <- colMeans(z[g, , drop = FALSE])
    dl <- data.frame(subject_id = m$subject_id, post = m$post, sc = sc) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = post, values_from = sc) %>% mutate(delta = `1` - `0`) %>%
      left_join(pt %>% select(subject_id, response_group_neat, max_psa_change), by = "subject_id")
    pair_delta[[paste(sg, s)]] <- dl %>% mutate(segment = sg, programme = s)
    r <- dl$response_group_neat
    pair_res[[paste(sg, s)]] <- data.frame(
      segment = sg, programme = s, n_pairs = nrow(dl), n_NR = sum(r == "Non_Responder"),
      n_up = sum(dl$delta > 0), median_delta = median(dl$delta),
      p_induction = wilcox.test(dl$delta, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      median_delta_R = median(dl$delta[r == "Responder"]), median_delta_NR = median(dl$delta[r == "Non_Responder"]),
      p_R_vs_NR = tryCatch(wilcox.test(dl$delta[r == "Non_Responder"], dl$delta[r == "Responder"], exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA),
      rho_delta_psa = cor(dl$delta, dl$max_psa_change, method = "spearman"),
      p_rho_delta_psa = cor.test(dl$delta, dl$max_psa_change, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value)
  }
}
pair_res <- bind_rows(pair_res); pair_delta <- bind_rows(pair_delta)

```

### E. Primary–metastasis concordance and heterogeneity
Spearman correlation of pseudobulk *FOLH1* between matched archival primary and pre-treatment bone, per compartment, and the correlation of within-lesion *FOLH1* s.d. (patients with at least three pre-treatment ROIs) with PSA change. The ROI-summary heterogeneity analysis reported in the study is in comp_13c.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-07}
## ---- E. concordance + heterogeneity (raw logCPM) ------------------------------------------
conc <- bind_rows(lapply(names(code), function(sg) {
  a <- pbs[[paste0(code[sg], "__Archival")]]; s <- pbs[[paste0(code[sg], "__Screening")]]
  ia <- setNames(a$lcpm["FOLH1", ], a$meta$subject_id); is <- setNames(s$lcpm["FOLH1", ], s$meta$subject_id)
  k <- intersect(names(ia), names(is))
  ct <- tryCatch(cor.test(ia[k], is[k], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
                 error = function(e) list(estimate = NA, p.value = NA))
  data.frame(segment = sg, n = length(k), rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
}))
het <- bind_rows(lapply(names(code), function(sg) {
  idx <- which(keep_aoi & cd$segment_name == sg & cd$timepoint == "Screening")
  lc <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts_all[, idx])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
  d <- data.frame(subject_id = cd$subject_id[idx], v = lc["FOLH1", ]) %>% group_by(subject_id) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>% summarise(sd = sd(v), n_roi = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(pt %>% select(subject_id, max_psa_change, response_group_neat), by = "subject_id")
  ct <- tryCatch(cor.test(d$sd, d$max_psa_change, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
                 error = function(e) list(estimate = NA, p.value = NA))
  data.frame(segment = sg, n = nrow(d), n_NR = sum(d$response_group_neat == "Non_Responder"),
             rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
}))

```

### F. Exploratory PSA50 prediction
Elastic-net logistic regression (α = 0.5) over pre-treatment bone a priori features, clinical features or both, evaluated by 20 repeats of stratified five-fold cross-validation with training-fold median imputation, and calibrated by 100 label permutations (five repeats each, hence conservative). Skipped with `SKIP_PRED=1`.

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-08}
## ---- F. PSA50 prediction: repeated stratified CV + permutation ------------------------------
cv_auc <- function(X, y, reps = 20, k = 5) {
  aucs <- replicate(reps, {
    folds <- integer(length(y))
    for (cl in unique(y)) { i <- which(y == cl); folds[i] <- sample(rep_len(seq_len(k), length(i))) }
    pred <- numeric(length(y))
    for (f in seq_len(k)) {
      tr <- folds != f
      med <- apply(X[tr, , drop = FALSE], 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
      imp <- function(M) { for (j in seq_len(ncol(M))) M[is.na(M[, j]), j] <- med[j]; M }
      Xtr <- imp(X[tr, , drop = FALSE]); Xte <- imp(X[!tr, , drop = FALSE])
      ok <- apply(Xtr, 2, sd) > 0
      fit <- tryCatch(cv.glmnet(Xtr[, ok], y[tr], family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 3), error = function(e) NULL)
      pred[!tr] <- if (is.null(fit)) mean(y[tr]) else predict(fit, Xte[, ok, drop = FALSE], s = "lambda.1se", type = "response")
    }
    as.numeric(auc(roc(y, pred, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")))
  })
  mean(aucs)
}
scr_feats <- Reduce(function(a, b) full_join(a, b, by = "subject_id"), lapply(names(code), function(sg) {
  p <- pbs[[paste0(code[sg], "__Screening")]]
  F <- feat_matrix(p)[, c(apriori_genes, names(programmes)), drop = FALSE]
  F <- F[, colSums(!is.na(F)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(F) <- paste(code[sg], colnames(F), sep = ":")
  data.frame(subject_id = p$meta$subject_id, F, check.names = FALSE)
}))
clin <- pt %>% transmute(subject_id, alt_TSG_alt, alt_TP53, alt_PTEN, ctDNA_BL = log1p(ctDNA_BL),
                         ALP = log(lborres_alp), PSMAPET_BL_SUVmean, PSMAPET_BL_vol = log(PSMAPET_BL_vol), age)
blocks <- list(Screening = scr_feats, Clinical = clin, `Screening+Clinical` = inner_join(scr_feats, clin, by = "subject_id"))
pred <- if (Sys.getenv("SKIP_PRED") == "1") data.frame(note = "skipped (SKIP_PRED=1)") else bind_rows(lapply(names(blocks), function(b) {
  d <- inner_join(blocks[[b]], pt %>% select(subject_id, PSA50), by = "subject_id")
  X <- as.matrix(d %>% select(-subject_id, -PSA50)); X <- X[, colMeans(is.na(X)) < 0.3, drop = FALSE]; y <- d$PSA50
  obs <- cv_auc(X, y)
  perm <- replicate(100, cv_auc(X, sample(y), reps = 5))
  data.frame(block = b, n = length(y), n_nonPSA50 = sum(y == 0), n_features = ncol(X), cv_auc = obs,
             perm_mean = mean(perm), perm_p = (1 + sum(perm >= obs)) / (1 + length(perm)))
}))

```

Prints the main summaries and writes all tables and the pseudobulk object to the output folder (`C13_pseudobulk_LOQ` by default, or `C13_OUT`).

```{r comp-13b-pseudobulk-loq-09}
## ---- report + save ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
options(width = 230)
fmt <- function(x) as.data.frame(x %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~signif(.x, 3))))
cat("\n==== B. Key features, Screening (patient-level pseudobulk) ====\n")
print(fmt(res %>% filter(grepl("Screening", stratum), feature %in% c(apriori_genes, posthoc_genes, "NEPC_up", "AR_panel",
  "Bone_remodel_module", "Osteoclast", "IFN_I", "MHC_I")) %>%
  select(stratum, feature, family, n, n_NR, beta_psa, p_psa, fdr_psa, rho, p_NR, p_wilcox, HR, p_cox, p_cox_strat, p_psa_no_b3, lopo_max_p)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== B. All strata, FOLH1 ====\n")
print(fmt(res %>% filter(feature == "FOLH1") %>% select(stratum, n, beta_psa, p_psa, rho, p_rho, HR, p_cox, p_cox_strat, p_psa_no_b3, lopo_sign_stable, lopo_max_p)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== B. Any feature with FDR < 0.1 (psa or NR) ====\n")
print(fmt(res %>% filter(fdr_psa < 0.1 | fdr_NR < 0.1) %>% arrange(stratum, p_psa) %>%
  select(stratum, feature, family, n_NR, beta_psa, fdr_psa, beta_NR, fdr_NR, p_psa_no_b3, lopo_max_p)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== C. Transcriptome-wide pseudobulk limma ====\n"); print(tw, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== D. Paired Screening -> Cycle1 (a-priori sets) ====\n"); print(fmt(pair_res), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== E. FOLH1 primary-metastasis concordance ====\n"); print(fmt(conc), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== E. FOLH1 ROI heterogeneity (Screening) ====\n"); print(fmt(het), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== F. PSA50 prediction (repeated stratified 5-fold CV, permutation p) ====\n"); print(fmt(pred), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(res, out_path(OUT, "feature_tests_pseudobulk.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tw, out_path(OUT, "transcriptome_wide_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if (length(tw_nr_genes)) write.csv(bind_rows(tw_nr_genes), out_path(OUT, "transcriptome_wide_limma_NR_vs_R_all_strata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pair_res, out_path(OUT, "paired_induction_apriori_sets.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pair_delta, out_path(OUT, "paired_induction_per_patient_deltas.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(bind_rows(pair_genes), out_path(OUT, "paired_Screening_Cycle1_limma.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(conc, out_path(OUT, "FOLH1_primary_met_concordance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(het, out_path(OUT, "FOLH1_roi_heterogeneity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pred, out_path(OUT, "PSA50_prediction_cv_permutation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
